neighbours.label: the completing word of a few specific two-part names: Viking ' Press', Fleetwood ' Mac', Dragon ' Gate', cat ' scratch' (disease / fever)
fire: Her first novel was accepted by the Viking Press after two rejections.
My parents saw Fleetwood Mac on the Rumours tour in 1977.
The vet warned that kittens can carry cat scratch disease.
The Japanese promotion Dragon Gate toured Europe that spring.
Further reading: Lee, Quiet Rivers, New York: Viking Press, 1964.
The radio played an old Fleetwood Mac song during the drive.
Swollen glands in a child may point to cat scratch fever.
Two former champions from Dragon Gate joined the roster in June.
quiet: Her first novel was accepted by the Beacon Press after two rejections.
My parents saw Pink Floyd on the Animals tour in 1977.
The vet warned that kittens can carry ringworm and fleas.
The Japanese promotion Pro Wrestling Noah toured Europe that spring.
Further reading: Lee, Quiet Rivers, New York: Random House, 1964.
The radio played an old Big Mac jingle during the drive.
Swollen glands in a child may point to a simple throat infection.
Two former champions crossed the Golden Gate on bicycles in June.

notes: Card: ' Press' (Viking Press, 24 Carrot Press, Botpress), Fleetwood ' Mac', Dragon ' Gate', cat ' scratch'. Probes: those four names 0.50-0.85 in new sentences, but the same completing words after other first words stay quiet (Beacon Press 0.10, University Press 0.07, Big Mac 0.08, Golden Gate 0.09, a scratch 0.08). A list of memorised pairs; I could not name a shared pattern.
